title: Moray's Util
description: A util mod to make Minecraft more convenient such as the compaction of certain blocks
body:
Tired of cobblestone, netherrack, and other blocks clogging up space in your chest? well now that wont be a probelm anymore. With currently 4 different compaction blocks you can reduce the inventory space taken up by hours of mining. In the future there will be more means of making things easier for your world.


--------
There are definitely no structures or secret items in the world



future:
add curios functionality
more compactions
definitely not anymore secret structures
other cool items
